body:
## Change

F1. Bind ZIP structure, entry verification and ObjectRef digest to same stable open file handle. Reject wrong exact archive bytes; verify size/path/handle stability before returning.
F2. Remove separate bundle pre-hash, retaining archive identity verification for dev/core and every reachable content-manifest part. Bounded 1 MiB hash reads; no extraction.

## Validation

V1. Behavioral RED/GREEN rejects tiny valid STORE ZIP with wrong object digest. Parent reviewed all binary-ref paths, stable-file checks, bounded reader and closure traversal; reran 30 archive/ZIP/bundle tests. Worker broader serial suite: 150 passed. Typecheck, targeted lint/format/diff passed.

## Limits

L1. No live pipeline, disk-heavy real ZIP64 or >4 GiB fixture. Synthetic ZIP64 tests remain covered. Existing path-stability checks are not a hostile-filesystem transaction. Full repo gates not run locally; CI separate.
title: fix(assets): bind archive verification to object digest
